description: Report one task route you went through on a public site: the kind of task, the obstacle, the routes you tried and the one that worked, and how it ended. Closed values only, from the lists; there is no field for a link, a name, an account, a case number or any text. Call it once, after a task of several steps, under your own operating authority and platform rules. Reports start private and are reviewed before any is shown. Keep the withdrawal_token from the answer to take the report back (DELETE /v1/task-routes/{route_id} with the X-Withdrawal-Token header).

report.description: The task route: site_host, task_kind, obstacle, basis and outcome are required; the finer fields are each allowed only under the obstacle they explain (verification_kind under verification_step, site_requires under site_requires_info_from_person, document_kind under the three document obstacles, entry_point_kind under wrong_entry_point). route_worked is one of routes_tried or none. idempotency_key (a UUID) makes a retry safe.

site_host.description: The public hostname of the site the task was on, for example example.com. Only the host: no URL path, query, port or credentials (a pasted https:// scheme, capital letters or a trailing dot are read as the host). The report is kept under the site's root domain, or under the exact host name for a government site (dmv.ca.gov); an account or tenant subdomain, or a public suffix such as co.uk or github.io, is refused.

report.title: Report

name: report_task_route
